Based on the available evidence for the software product **BabelOn** at **`babelontrip.com`**:

* **Vendor / Provider:** **BabelOn** (also published under the developer name **babelontrip**).
* **Evidence:**
  * The official service at `babelontrip.com` operates under the brand **BabelOn** (*"ia Your AI Trip Planner... Plan a trip; Explore... BabelOn AI"*).
  * The startup showcase for SXSW 2024 lists the operating startup entity directly as **BabelOn** (United States, website: `https://babelontrip.com/`): *"BabelOn is an AI Trip Planner helping you plan your perfect trip in under 60 seconds. Plan every aspect of your trip... all with the power of AI!"*.
  * Software catalog specifications (e.g., Softonic) explicitly list the publisher/developer as **babelontrip** (*"BabelOn for Web Apps · By babelontrip"* / *"Developer: babelontrip"*).
